function HashThis pDataToHash,pHashVersion 
	local tHashOut
	if pHashVersion = "" then
		get binarydecode("H*",messagedigest(pDataToHash,"sha-256"),tHashOut)
	else
		get binarydecode("H*",messagedigest(pDataToHash,pHashVersion),tHashOut)
	end if
	return tHashOut
end HashThis
